contract.purpose: RolePatch helps job seekers prepare a resume for a specific role by connecting the job requirements to supplied experience and showing a reviewable patch.
contract.canonicalPurpose: RolePatch tailors a resume and supporting application material to the evidence and language of a specific job.
contract.audience: A job seeker preparing a serious application for a particular role.
contract.job: Understand the resume + job → editable draft → portable export workflow and enter the guest workspace.
contract.thesis: Precision Studio: a precise software instrument that makes source and proposed wording equally visible.
contract.system: Geist display/interface with Georgia resume specimens. Graphite actions, off-white page, neutral working canvas, green source-grounded edits. Centered proposition, three-pane job/source/draft workbench, dark redline interlude, horizontal method and ruled export/access ledger. Shared 8px spacing rhythm and 1232px content boundary. Existing footer and its inherited global styles frozen; new rules scoped to the header/main and app workspace.
contract.signature: The job requirement, original resume and proposed wording share one working canvas; the dark redline section exposes the preserved source fact and unsupported requirement.
contract.risk: The centered proposition is more conventional than Folio, but its side-by-side source/draft workbench makes the resume-specific mechanism concrete. Mobile prioritizes the tailored paper and exposes source comparison in the actual app. Frozen footer retains its legacy treatment.
contract.qualityBar: Address the owner concern: premium enough across the entire page, not only the hero. Distinctive typography and composition, legible paper, varied chapter rhythm, honest illustrative proof and access, a coherent app, mobile reflow. No fake metrics/testimonials or UI/source changes to the footer. See brief.md.

checkpoints.findingsReview: First scan found low-contrast secondary labels and paper footer text. Darkened them; reviewed landing/app scans are 16/11 with no low-contrast trigger. Instrument Serif italic accents and existing Geist are deliberate, not evidence of authorship. Uppercase resume sections, three process steps and native FAQ serve the task. Desktop headline wrap was corrected; tablet nav and document reflow were corrected in rendered review.

Reviewed landing/app scans are 24/11. Reduced crushed display tracking and corrected paper caption contrast. The centered proposition is an intentional software direction and its conventional nature is a stated tradeoff. The framed workbench encloses actual original/draft papers, rather than decorative nested marketing cards. Existing Geist, resume labels, numbered process and FAQ are intentional.

Contrast in the paper footer and bright patch captions corrected before reviewed scans. Full-body composition was then revised to vertical chapters, horizontal formats, full-width pricing and narrow FAQ so it differs materially from Folio beyond palette/hero. Existing Geist utilities, serif paper, dark working environment, numbered process and native FAQ are intentional; report contains actual measured results. Final direction scan 23 landing/15 app; horizontal token-pack prices trigger stat-banner, retained as real pricing rather than performance/outcome proof. No low-contrast trigger remains.

First working Astro render and fresh empty guest dashboard, not the populated personal browser workspace. Landing 24: selected Geist, centered proposition, uppercase resume sections, native FAQ and document panes remain intentional. Actual rendered review found old section padding doubling the dark interlude, process specificity reverting to three cramped columns, and inherited Tailwind color aliases leaving app actions blue. Scoped overrides corrected all three; no shared footer CSS changed. Guest scanner state has no stored resume, so populated paper/explanation craft is qualified separately by CUA screenshots.

Final actual built landing 24 and fresh empty guest dashboard22, same pin/definitions/preset/viewport as iteration. Geist, centered hero, uppercase manuscript labels, numbered rows, native FAQ and genuine manuscript panes are intentional selected choices. Dashboard icon/nested cards and sparkle come from retained native secondary tools, not new landing proof. No low-contrast or crushed-tracking trigger. Direct review fixed method specificity, legacy padding, color aliases and phone score-panel clipping; independent review recognizes illustrative proof and honest base state. Numeric scans do not establish quality or owner acceptance.

identity.observation: Same established arrow, graphite actions and neutral surfaces; source-grounded resume patch is the signature. Frozen footer deliberately keeps its existing treatment.

interaction.observation: Actual CTA, retained guest resume/job, pasted-description entry, keyboard FAQ, menu/context toggles and score explanation verified. Phone score clipping fixed; generated compare/export remain unqualified without local managed AI.

responsive.observation: Actual 390/768/1440 pair captures and DOM widths show no horizontal overflow. Tablet/phone explanations follow the paper; preparation remains accessible through disclosure.
